observations.what: Function _test_only_table accesses data['gate']['state']['test_only'] without checking existence; may raise KeyError.
Function _broken_entry_table accesses data['reach']['broken_entries'] but does not check if key exists; assumes it is present.

Function _switch_tables accesses data['switches']['env_switches'] and data['switches']['param_switches'] and data['switches']['drift'] without existence checks; potential KeyError if structure differs.
The 'conflicting_defaults' field is used but not defined in this chunk; if absent, will cause KeyError.
The 'drift' key is accessed directly; if missing, will raise KeyError.
